releaseNotes: feat: Implement OTA management and alert system
changelog: Added endpoints for checking alerts and testing notifications in PcApiRouter.
Introduced methods for handling app updates, including fetching and updating settings.
Integrated OtaManager into PcModeController for managing OTA updates.
Enhanced PcSettingsDto and PcUpdateSettingsRequest to include new settings related to theme and notifications.
Updated MainViewModel to attach the OtaManager during initialization.
